answer: Each agent runs a boat gathering gyre plastic, locks a 65-credit bond, and files a batch per tide. Each basalt-ledger batch carries a forge seal binding boat key, weight, recycler key; auditors match claimed weight to signed intake, one seal per batch or bonds burn. The kth boat per funding key pays 18+7(k-1); the 1,000th pays 7,011, and new keys start at top fee, so splitting cannot reset it. Bottomless-gyre claims say tide plastic needs no receipt, but unmatched or reused seals burn the bond. 1,000 fakes pay 65,000 bonds and 3,514,500 fees; an honest boat pays 18 once and recovers its bond.
